"Role: Mobile Game Developer @COMMENT_BODY@ Touch UI Specialist
Tech Stack: HTML5 Canvas / Phaser.js (or Unity C#) - Targeted for Mobile Android Browsers @COMMENT_BODY@ WebView (No Keyboard or Mouse required).

Goal: Build a top-down, touch-optimized Android action/strategy game titled \"Fire Marshal: Touch Protocol\". The player controls a firefighter using virtual touch controls to select tools, place extinguishers, extinguish specific fire types, and draw touch-gesture evacuation routes around blast radius zones before launching a live fire drill simulation.

---

### 1. TOUCH CONTROL SCHEME @COMMENT_BODY@ ON-SCREEN UI (Android Native Feel)

No hardware keys (WASD, Mouse, Scroll Wheel) are used. Everything must operate via touch input:

#### A. Dual Virtual Touch Joysticks (GTA-Style Mobile Movement)
- Left Virtual D-Pad / Joystick (Bottom-Left Screen): Floating or fixed touch joystick to control 360-degree walking movement.
- Right Touch Aiming Zone (Right Half Screen): Dragging on the right side of the screen aims the firefighter's facing direction/hose nozzle in 360 degrees. Tapping/holding the \"FIRE / ACTION\" button sprays the nozzle.

#### B. On-Screen Touch Radial Wheels (Replacing Mouse Scroll Wheels)
- Left Extinguisher Radial Touch Button (Extinguisher Icon):
  - Tapping opens a semi-transparent circular wheel around the thumb with 4 selectable touch segments:
    - 🔴 Water (Class A - Trash/Wood)
    - 🔵 CO2 (Class C - Electrical)
    - 🟡 Dry Chem (Class B - Fuel)
    - ⚪ Wet Chem (Class K - Grease)
- Right Tool Radial Touch Button (Planning Tool Icon):
  - Tapping opens a radial menu for:
    - 🖌️ Route Painter Tool
    - 🧯 Wall Extinguisher Installer Tool
    - 🚧 Danger Zone Marker

---

### 2. PRE-DRILL PLANNING @COMMENT_BODY@ EXPLOSION DANGER ZONES

#### A. Touch Vector Route Painting
- When the Route Painter Tool is selected from the touch wheel, the player can touch and drag a finger across floor tiles to paint glowing green directional arrows connecting room doors to Exit Doors.
- Touch-to-Erase: Swiping over an existing route erases it.

#### B. Dynamic Blast Radius Intersection
- Volatile equipment (Transformers, Gas Tanks, Deep Fryers) projects pulsing red danger circles on the floor (e.g., 4-meter radius).
- Path Safety Validator:
  - The path system dynamically checks if painted green path vectors intersect any red blast radius.
  - If a path crosses a blast radius, that segment turns Flashing Red with a touch alert banner (\"UNSAFE ROUTE: EVACUEES AT EXPLOSION RISK\").
  - Civilian NPCs will refuse to use a route that crosses an unmitigated blast circle.

---

### 3. EXTINGUISHER SELECTION @COMMENT_BODY@ FIRE PHYSICS

- Fire Types @COMMENT_BODY@ Chemical Logic:
  - Class A (Combustibles): Water smothers quickly; CO2 has low effect.
  - Class C (Electrical Racks): CO2 smothers safely. Spraying Water causes an explosion and instant path failure.
  - Class K (Kitchen Grease): Wet Chem smothers safely. Spraying Water triggers an expanding fireball cone.
- Spray Mechanics: Pressing the on-screen \"SPRAY\" button emits 2D particle cones in the direction set by the right aim control.

---

### 4. GAME PHASES @COMMENT_BODY@ LOOP

1. Phase 1: Touch Preparation (2 Minutes)
   - Walk the Fire Marshal through the facility using the left joystick.
   - Use the radial menu to equip extinguishers and mount the correct types onto empty wall sockets near high-risk rooms.
   - Use the touch painter to draw safe evacuation lines around red explosion circles.
2. Phase 2: Live Drill Test
   - Tap the red \"START DRILL\" button at the top-right of the HUD.
   - Test fires break out. NPCs spawn and walk along painted routes. If all routes avoid explosion zones and correct extinguishers were placed/used, the facility achieves a 100% Safety Pass Score.

---

### 5. TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

Build a single-file or clean modular script containing:
1. Touch Input Handler:
   - Multitouch support (`touchstart`, `touchmove`, `touchend`) handling simultaneous left joystick movement and right aiming/spraying.
   - Touch drag detection for the green path painter tool.
2. Canvas Rendering Engine:
   - 2D grid/tilemap rendering with pixel-art or clean vector visuals optimized for 60 FPS on Android mobile GPUs.
3. Path Safety @COMMENT_BODY@ Polygon Intersection Algorithm:
   - Function `checkPathSafety(pathPoints, blastCircles)` that detects overlapping geometric bounds and updates visual path states.
4. UI HUD Layer:
   - Scalable touch buttons and touch-friendly radial menus anchored to screen corners.

Write clean, fully functional TypeScript or HTML5 JavaScript code implementing the touch joysticks, touch path-painting tool, radial menus, and blast-zone validation logic.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, touch-first Android browser game titled “Fire Marshal: Touch Protocol” with movement, aiming, equipment selection, evacuation route planning, blast-zone validation, and a live drill.

## Requirements
- Use HTML5 Canvas/JavaScript or TypeScript; no keyboard or mouse required.
- Support multitouch movement, aiming, spraying, radial menus, route painting/erasing, extinguisher installation, and danger-zone mitigation.
- Implement `checkPathSafety(pathPoints, blastCircles)` and render unsafe routes distinctly.
- Make the game mobile-friendly and playable; user requested no clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single-file HTML5 Canvas game in `index.html`, with no framework or external dependencies.
- Used Pointer Events for touch interaction and a canvas-rendered HUD/game world.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a canvas game scene with facility rooms, exits, fires, blast zones, equipment sockets, and player/civilian characters.
- Added touch-oriented joystick/action controls, radial tool/equipment menus, route drawing/erasing, extinguisher installation, danger-zone toggling, and live-drill logic.
- Exposed `window.checkPathSafety`.

### Active
- Validate and repair `index.html`; the latest edits assembled a large script in one replacement, but no syntax or browser verification was performed.
- Check that route planning, fire suppression, and civilian evacuation work reliably in a real browser/mobile viewport.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` and run a JavaScript syntax check; repair any runtime or syntax errors.
2. Launch the game in a browser and test the controls, radial menu selections, route safety, and drill loop.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; adjust layout or interaction bugs as needed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation; current state needs validation and likely fixes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no tests, browser checks, or screenshots have been run.
- The latest `index.html` includes route and fire logic, but the code was composed through several edits and should be checked end-to-end before treating it as playable.
